summary: Sadot Group Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an assignment of an outstanding February 2026 8% unsecured OID debenture (principal $271,739.13) by Nata Solutions to a third party, then settled that debt by issuing 32,909 common shares under Section 3(a)(9) — implying a conversion price near $8.26 per share. The issuance is subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership limit and a 19.99% Nasdaq exchange cap without stockholder approval. This debt-for-equity swap reduces leverage but adds overhang. Watch for shareholder approval requests, further conversions, and dilution pressure.
